title: GSK
summary: British pharmaceutical group focused on vaccines, HIV and specialty medicines.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

GSK sells vaccines, HIV therapies through ViiV, respiratory and oncology medicines, and consumer-health products. It has been rebuilding its pipeline through acquisitions and is a major vaccine supplier globally. Litigation and patent expiries are recurring issues.

Technology Exposure

  • Vaccines
  • HIV and antiviral therapies
  • Respiratory and oncology medicines

What To Watch

  • Vaccine demand and pricing
  • HIV franchise competition
  • Litigation and patent expiries

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
